Job Description
Hej Software Engineer, 
Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA? 
With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to ask questions, share your ideas, learn from mistakes and grow together with others. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have opportunities to try things you haven’t done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people. 
 
We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems together with others to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Here you will help develop digital solutions that support product development, manufacturing, suppliers and the movement of IKEA products through our global value chain.  
We believe good software is created by teams where people bring different perspectives, share knowledge, ask questions and learn together. You don’t need to know everything from day one. Curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to keep learning matter to us. 
We are growing our team in Malmö and looking for someone who enjoys working with people across different roles, teams, cultures and locations. 
Qualifications
Your new job 
We’re looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems and learning together with others. Your strengths might be in frontend or backend development, or somewhere in between. What matters to us is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in growing and contributing across the stack. 
You’ll join a cross-functional team building and maintaining digital products across the stack, from backend services, APIs, integrations and databases to web applications and user experiences. You’ll have opportunities to build on your strengths while developing your skills in other areas. Together, we experiment, share knowledge and continuously improve how we design, build, test and deliver software. 
Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers. 
What we’d like you to bring to the table 
Experience building software solutions, with strengths in frontend, backend, or across the full stack.  
Experience with backend development using C#/.NET and REST APIs and/or frontend development using React, TypeScript or similar technologies.  
A good understanding of software design, data modelling, relational databases and building reliable, maintainable solutions.  
An ability to understand complex problems, break them down into manageable parts and work with others to find practical solutions. 
Experience with software testing and modern development practices, such as version control, continuous integration and automated delivery.  
Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure, GCP or AWS is valuable, but not essential.  
A collaborative mindset, curiosity and an interest in learning, sharing knowledge and improving together with your team.  
An interest in understanding the wider product and contributing beyond your main area of expertise. 

Additional Information
Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more! 
Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. 
Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. 
We welcome your application 
Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 19th of November. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses.  
This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  
Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Monaka Perumal; monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com. 
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
Employment: Temporary, 12-24 months
Location: Boden
What you’ll do
Right now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.
As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards

Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area

Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts

Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders

Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting

Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities

Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise

Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reporting

What you’ll bring
You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.
Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

3+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling or similar roles, preferably within industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM projects

Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Project Controls, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good understanding of project planning and scheduling methodologies

Experience developing, updating, and analyzing project schedules

Understanding of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), schedule integration, progress measurement, and forecasting

Ability to review contractor and EPCM schedules and identify constraints, risks, and inconsistencies

Experience using relevant planning and scheduling tools

Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with fluency in English

Benefits at Stegra 
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.
Our Boden Site
Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.
Boden Video

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
About the Role
As an Android Developer at the Operator Assistance department, you will be a part of a collaborative, enthusiastic team, developing intelligent safety systems that enable our operators to drive our machines safely in high-risk environments.
In our team we create innovative solutions where hardware, embedded software and deep learning come together to create our SmartView app. SmartView is our intelligent obstacle detection system that gives operators a 360° view of the machine’s surroundings. (More information on what you will work on: https://www.volvoce.com/sv-se/services/volvo-smart-view/ )
We work in an agile environment where the team collaborates to set direction, solve technical challenges, and continuously improve our solutions. In your role as an Android Developer, you will develop intuitive operator interfaces using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, integrate live camera feeds and machine data, and help bring AI-powered perception and safety alerts into our SmartView app. You will also troubleshoot and optimize the software to ensure reliable performance in demanding machine operating conditions.
If you are excited about making real difference in people’s lives and safety on your day-to-day work and seeing the impact of your innovative engineering, this job is for you!
Who are you?
You enjoy solving real-world problems through software development and are curious about how technology can make machines safer and smarter. You value collaboration, share ideas openly, and take ownership of your work.
You enjoy working in cross-functional teams, learning from others, and contributing to solutions in an international environment. You communicate effectively in English and are comfortable taking initiative, asking questions, and exploring new approaches to technical challenges.
Technical skills:
We are looking for someone with experience in Android development, particularly Kotlin and embedded systems. Experience with the following technologies is valuable:
Embedded Android development using Kotlin and C++
Android camera frameworks such as Camera2 or CameraX, or video streaming
CAN bus systems and machine data integration
CI/CD experience with pipelines
Working knowledge of the general mobile landscape, architectures, trends, and emerging technologies.
Edge AI frameworks knowledge, such as TensorFlow Lite or ONNX, particularly for vision or audio applications are an advantage
Knowledge in Sensor Fusion and Control Theory is an advantage

What’s in it for you?
This role is in our Eskilstuna site with our modern facilities, and you will be a part of our Technology Center, where you will have access to our exciting machines, have the opportunity to test what you develop and collaborate with all our stakeholders. At our Technology Center in Eskilstuna, you'll have opportunities to develop your technical expertise, explore new technologies, and grow your career within a large international organization.
In addition to technology and career opportunities, we offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, including flexible time, internal growth opportunities and compensation benefits such as Occupational pension – ITP (ITP1 & ITP2), profit sharing and company bonus. We value our employees’ well-being, work-life balance and having fun at work.
Ready for the next move?
If you are curious to explore how we put our words into actions, follow us on LinkedIn and volvogroup.com.
Last day to apply: 29th of November 2026
Location: Eskilstuna, Technology Center Headquarters, On-site
For questions about the position, please contact: Ceren Robinson, Head of Operator Assistance (ceren.robinson@volvo.com) or Olof Person, Talent Acquisition Partner(olof.person@volvo.com)
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
We look forward to receiving your application!
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

Job Title: Financial Controller
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
 
 
Role Summary
Do you enjoy combining financial expertise with collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement? As a Financial Controller within Group Reporting, you will have the opportunity to influence both the quality of Scania Group reporting and the way our finance processes develop over time.
You will be a trusted partner to finance teams around the world, helping them deliver accurate, timely, and compliant reporting. During the financial close, you will review and consolidate submissions, analyse outcomes, and resolve reporting issues together with the business. Between closings, you will have room to look ahead: improving processes, strengthening controls, developing reporting structures, and exploring how AI and automation can improve finance processes, decision support, and ways of working. This is a role where precision matters, but where curiosity, initiative, and the ability to bring people together are just as important.
 
Job Responsibilities
·      Review, validation, and consolidation of financial submissions from entities, ensuring accurate mappings, high data quality, and timely reporting in HFM.
·      Guide reporting entities through month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing, helping them interpret requirements and resolve issues in a practical and constructive way.
·      Turn complex financial information into clear insights through analytical reviews, variance analysis, and quality-assurance activities.
·      Share your expertise in IFRS, Group accounting policies, reporting instructions, financial models, and reporting systems through day-to-day support and training.
·      Drive improvements that make reporting simpler, more efficient, and more robust, including the responsible use of AI and automation, documentation, standards, internal controls, reporting structures, and master data.
·      Contribute to planning and forecast reporting, system governance, account mappings, change requests, finance transformation initiatives, and ad-hoc analysis.
 
Who You Are
You are someone who takes pride in delivering high-quality work and who enjoys making complicated topics easier for others to understand. You are analytical and attentive to detail, yet able to step back and see the bigger picture. Colleagues experience you as collaborative, dependable, and solution-oriented. You are comfortable taking ownership, asking the right questions, and turning identified issues into lasting improvements.

We believe you will bring:
·      A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
·      Several years of experience in financial controlling, Group reporting, consolidation, or audit, preferably in a large international organization.
·      Solid knowledge of IFRS, consolidated financial statements, Group accounting policies, and financial closing processes.
·      Hands-on experience with HFM or another consolidation or financial reporting system. 
·      Clear and confident communication skills in English, together with the ability to build trust across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.
·      An AI-oriented and improvement-driven mindset, with curiosity about how AI can be applied responsibly to simplify finance processes, strengthen quality, and create better insights. Previous experience with AI, automation, or finance transformation is a strong advantage.

This Is Us
 
You will join Group Reporting within Corporate Control at Scania’s head office in Södertälje. Our work connects local finance teams with Group-level reporting, which gives you broad exposure to Scania’s international operations and a strong professional network across the organization.
You will become part of a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared and new ideas are welcomed. The role offers a varied rhythm: focused teamwork during reporting periods and meaningful opportunities between closings to improve processes, controls, systems, and financial models, including identifying valuable and responsible applications of AI in finance. Your contribution will be visible in the reliability of our financial information and in how effectively we work together across the Group.

Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-13. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Group Manager, Fredrik Pasia, fredrik.pasia@scania.com

Arbetsbeskrivning

Do you have a strong background in heavy commercial vehicles, spare parts or technical aftermarket operations? Are you interested in developing your career within product management while working in an international organization?
This could be an opportunity to take the next step.

MEKO is looking for a Product Manager to support the continued expansion of its Commercial Vehicle Division under its FTZ brand in Denmark.

You will contribute to the development of product groups within trucks, trailers and buses, combining your technical industry knowledge with practical product management and commercial coordination.

We welcome candidates from both Denmark and Southern Sweden. Previous experience as a Product Manager is valuable but not essential. What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.

You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.
•	Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.
•	Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.
•	Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.
•	Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.
•	Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.
•	Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.

The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.

This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.


Din Profil

Your profile

We are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.

You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.

A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.

We believe you bring:

•	Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.
•	Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.
•	An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.
•	Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.
•	Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.
It is advantageous if you also have:
•	Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.
•	Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.
•	Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.
•	A post-secondary technical education.

Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.


Om företaget

About MEKO

MEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.

The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.
In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.

As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.


Kontaktuppgifter

Contact

In this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

We look forward to your application!

Arbetsbeskrivning

FTZ | Rørup, Denmark

Join FTZ and help develop our growing Heavy Commercial Vehicles business
FTZ is looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our expanding Commercial Vehicle Division in Denmark. In this role, you will work with product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, including trucks, trailers and buses, and contribute to developing an attractive and competitive product offering for the Danish aftermarket.

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of commercial vehicles and their components, combined with an interest in product management and commercial development. Whether your background is in product management, spare parts, technical sales or workshop operations, your industry knowledge and motivation could make you the right person for this opportunity.

You will join a growing business area where you can make a real impact, working closely with experienced colleagues both locally and across the MEKO Group.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager at FTZ, you will work within MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division, supporting the development and management of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles.
Based on sales and profitability objectives, you will collaborate with colleagues to ensure that the right product range, competitive pricing and accurate product information are in place, while maintaining close dialogue with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying, initiating and supporting projects for the launch of new products.
•	Preparing request-for-quotation material and product specifications for sourcing, and evaluating products in cooperation with colleagues across MEKO countries.
•	Managing product phase-in and phase-out activities.
•	Maintaining and administering product information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitors and supporting pricing activities.
•	Following up on product assortments, price levels, product performance and relevant actions related to obsolescence, returns and assortment changes.
•	Acting as a product expert within your areas and supporting the sales organization with technical knowledge.
•	Contributing to the development of an attractive and competitive product offering for customers.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining operational product management with opportunities to contribute to commercial development. You will have regular contact with suppliers, sales teams, product colleagues and logistics functions.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles and the Group Category Manager, who provides strategic category direction and support. The position does not include personnel management.


Din Profil

Your profile

Your understanding of Heavy Commercial Vehicles and their components is the most important qualification for this position.

We are looking for someone with relevant experience from trucks, trailers, buses or a closely related heavy-duty industry. You may currently work in product management, spare parts, technical sales, workshop operations, parts distribution or a similar role. Experience from agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may also be relevant.

To succeed in the role, we believe you have:

•	Solid practical knowledge of commercial vehicles, their components and applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work 
•	Good computer literacy and the willingness to work extensively with digital product information and systems.
•	A structured, service-minded and proactive approach to your work.
•	An interest in product development, assortment management and commercial opportunities.
•	Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and countries.
•	Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

The following qualifications are considered advantages rather than requirements:

•	Previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Specialist or Category Manager.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP systems such as AX or Enterprise, or Product Information Management (PIM).
•	Strong analytical skills and experience working with product or sales data.
•	Danish or other Nordic language skills.
•	Post-secondary technical education.

What matters is your technical understanding, your motivation and your willingness to develop your product management capabilities.


Om företaget

About FTZ

FTZ is one of Denmark's leading automotive aftermarket distributors, supplying spare parts, tools and solutions to professional workshops and automotive businesses.

As part of the MEKO Group, FTZ combines its strong position in Denmark with the expertise, purchasing capabilities and international network of one of Northern Europe's leading automotive aftermarket groups.

The Commercial Vehicle Division is a growing business area focused on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications. You will join an organization with strong technical and commercial competence, close cooperation across countries and opportunities to contribute to the continued expansion of the business.

MEKO operates across eight European countries through established brands, including FTZ, Mekonomen and MECA. The Group drives development in digitalization, logistics and sustainable mobility solutions, with a vision to enable mobility today, tomorrow and in the future.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.


Kontaktuppgifter

In this recruitment, FTZ Denmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

. Mips gives you the confidence to follow your passion. Whether you are training for fitness, riding to work, heading out on the mountain or playing team sports, our mission is leading the world to safer helmets. Mips specializes in helmet-based safety and is a world-leader in this area. Based on an ingredient brand business-model, Mips’ safety system is sold to the global helmet industry. The technology is based on over 25 years of research and development together with the Royal Institute of Technology and the Karolinska Institute, both located in Stockholm, Sweden. Mips’ headquarter with 84 employees engaged in research and development, sales, marketing and administration is in Stockholm, where its product and technology test facility also is located. The Mips share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap.  For more information: www.mipscorp.com 2025, Mips announced its acquisition of KOROYD, strengthening the company’s world-leading helmet safety technology portfolio with complementary technology. Recognizing the potential synergies between the two brands and their respective technologies, Mips and KOROYD will continue to operate separately under their respective leadership teams.  www.koroyd.com
As Mips grows across brands, markets and channels, digital is becoming a central driver of commercial value. We are now looking for a Digital Lead to own our digital agenda and turn it into one clear strategy, one operating model and a well-directed investment portfolio.
The roleYou set the direction for how digital creates commercial value across brands, markets and channels, you decide where the digital investment goes, and you lead the team and partners who deliver it. You are part of the marketing leadership team, with a group-level mandate across both Mips and Koroyd. Your mission is to build a unified digital strategy that bridges the gap between B2B ingredient branding and B2C consumer pull.
What you will do 
Set the digital strategy and roadmap. Define the multi-year strategy, anchored in company strategy and the commercial plan, and translate business objectives into priorities, targets and a prioritized portfolio of initiatives.
Own the digital ecosystem for Mips and Koroyd. Paid media, website, social media, SEO, ambassador and influencer marketing, and e-commerce campaigns. Set targets and KPIs per channel and decide on reallocation across the mix, while each brand keeps its own distinct presence and tone of voice.
Own the digital investment. Be responsible for the total digital investment across media, platforms, technology, agencies and resources. Set business cases and return requirements, propose the annual budget and own in-year reallocation, with a clear cost-efficiency and ROI focus.
Lead data, marketing technology and AI. Own the marketing technology stack and the data, measurement and attribution model behind all reporting and optimization. Set the AI agenda across search and generative engine optimization, AI-assisted shopping and product discovery across our digital ecosystem, and AI-driven content and campaign production.
Set governance and manage risk. Establish decision rights, standards and quality gates, and own digital risk and compliance together with Legal, including privacy, consent, accessibility and platform policy.
Build the team and the operating model. Lead a team of three digital specialists (analytics and performance, website and social media), design one digital operating model for the group, secure the right competence in the digital team and build digital capability across the wider business.
Represent digital at the top. Present performance, risks and investment cases to the executive team and the Board together with the Head of Marketing, and own senior relationships with agencies, platform partners and technology vendors, including negotiating master agreements. 

What success looks like in your first 12 to 18 months 
One digital strategy and roadmap for Mips and Koroyd, agreed with leadership.
A common operating model with shared platforms, standards, agencies and ways of working, and a distinct digital presence for each brand.
A highly functional digital team with the right competence for the opreating model.
A measurement and attribution model and a clear plan for the marketing technology stack.
An AI roadmap with concrete use cases, guardrails and productivity targets across search, commercial and production.
A digital investment portfolio with business cases and return requirements, built into the next annual planning cycle.

Who you are
You have led digital at scale in a multi-brand or international environment, with a track record of results and of delivering digital transformation.
You have line management experience and have developed specialist teams.
You have owned digital investment decisions: business cases, return requirements and trade-offs across channels, markets and technology.
You understand the full digital ecosystem, marketing technology and data, and have a practical view of how AI is changing search, e-commerce and content production.
You are commercially minded and credible with executives, agencies and vendors, and comfortable negotiating.
You set direction and prioritize, and you build trust across brands and teams.
You are fluent in English. Swedish is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Gör teknik begriplig – Technical Writer/ Teknikinformatör på Saab Dynamics
jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera ditt teknikintresse med din förmåga att skriva tydligt och pedagogiskt? Hos Saab Dynamics i Boden får du skapa dokumentation som hjälper människor att använda och underhålla avancerade system på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur teknik fungerar och som tycker om att göra komplex information begriplig. Du kan vara en erfaren teknikinformatör eller ha en annan relevant bakgrund och vilja utvecklas inom teknisk dokumentation.
 
Din roll
Du tar fram teknisk dokumentation för digitala ledningsstödsystem som används av Försvarsmakten. Systemen omfattar bland annat datorer, nätverk och radio- och kommunikationsutrustning på olika typer av fordon, båtar och soldatsystem.
Din uppgift är att omvandla tekniskt underlag och kunskap från våra experter till tydliga manualer och instruktioner. Dokumentationen hjälper operatörer och tekniker att förstå, använda och underhålla systemen – och är en viktig del av den lösning vi levererar till kunden.
Du arbetar nära systemingenjörer, konstruktörer, projektledare, produktledare och användare. Du driver dina egna uppgifter och är samtidigt en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är viktiga delar av vardagen.
 
Det här kommer du att arbeta med
Samla in och analysera tekniskt underlag i dialog med sakkunniga.
Strukturera och skriva användarmanualer, instruktioner och underhållsdokumentation.
Granska och kvalitetssäkra innehåll tillsammans med tekniska experter.
Anpassa informationen efter användarnas behov och förkunskaper.
Uppdatera dokumentationen när systemen utvecklas eller förändras.
Bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, metoder och dokumentationsprocesser.

Vi producerar dokumentation på svenska och engelska i en XML-baserad miljö enligt S1000D, en internationell specifikation för strukturerad teknisk dokumentation.
 
Det här får du möjlighet till
Hos oss arbetar du nära både tekniken och människorna som kan den. Du får fördjupa din tekniska förståelse, utveckla din kompetens inom teknikinformation och vara med och påverka hur vi arbetar med dokumentation.
Framför allt får du skapa information som fyller en konkret funktion: att ge användarna rätt förutsättningar att lösa sina uppgifter. Ditt arbete bidrar till Saabs uppdrag att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen – Keeping People and Society Safe.
 
Din profil
Du har ett teknikintresse och en god förmåga att sätta dig in i hur produkter och system fungerar. Du skriver tydligt och strukturerat och tycker om att förklara sådant som andra kan uppleva som komplicerat.
Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom teknisk dokumentation, ingenjörsarbete, teknisk utbildning, support eller service och underhåll. Du kan ha en relevant utbildning eller ha byggt upp motsvarande kunskaper genom arbete.
För att lyckas i rollen behöver du
Kunna uttrycka dig mycket väl på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
Kunna analysera och strukturera teknisk information.
Arbeta noggrant och vilja säkerställa att informationen är korrekt och användbar.
Trivas med att samarbeta och ställa frågor till personer med olika kompetenser.

Du behöver inte kunna våra system från början. Däremot vill vi att du är nyfiken, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och vill lära dig mer.
Erfarenheter som är meriterande
Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande, men det är inte ett krav:
Teknisk dokumentation, exempelvis användarmanualer eller underhållsinstruktioner.
S1000D eller Simplified Technical English, STE.
XML-baserade publiceringsmiljöer eller innehållshanteringssystem, CMS, exempelvis UPTIME.
Teknisk illustration eller bildbearbetning i Adobe Illustrator eller Photoshop.
Försvarsmakten, FMV eller dokumentation i verksamheter med höga krav på kvalitet och spårbarhet.

Vi välkomnar både dig som är i början av karriären och dig som har flera års relevant erfarenhet.
Placering och resor
Tjänsten är placerad i Boden. Resor förekommer i arbetet.
 
Befattningen kräver
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassning kan, i förekommande fall, krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.
 
Ansökan
Saab Dynamics har valt att samarbeta med AxÖ Consulting för denna rekrytering. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Per Nyqvist, Saab Dynamics, 073 – 446 86 38 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson, AxÖ Consulting, 070 – 842 23 35.
Urvalsprocessen sker löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas före ansökningstidens utgång, så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag 25 november.
Ansökan endast via länk intill.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – här får du möjlighet att göra skillnad.
 
Vad du blir en del av
Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan.
Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen.
AxÖ Consulting AB har lång och gedigen erfarenhet från rekryterings- och konsultbranschen och har arbetat med såväl privat marknad som inom offentlig sektor. För mer information och ansökan besök www.axoconsulting.se. Vi tar tyvärr inte emot ansökningar via brev eller e-post.

Samla in och analysera tekniskt underlag i dialog med sakkunniga.
Strukturera och skriva användarmanualer, instruktioner och underhållsdokumentation.
Granska och kvalitetssäkra innehåll tillsammans med tekniska experter.
Anpassa informationen efter användarnas behov och förkunskaper.
Uppdatera dokumentationen när systemen utvecklas eller förändras.
Bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, metoder och dokumentationsprocesser.

Trivas med att samarbeta och ställa frågor till personer med olika kompetenser.

jobs.description:
Advancing specialty steel through research and innovation 
From metallurgical research to real-world applicationsDeveloping specialty steel for demanding applications requires a deep understanding of materials, a curiosity to investigate complex problems and the ability to turn scientific findings into practical solutions. At Ovako, this also means working with customers to understand their challenges and exploring how steel can help them develop new products, improve performance and bring new ideas to life. 
As a leading European producer of specialty steel, Ovako combines more than 300 years of industrial expertise with modern technology and a strong commitment to sustainability. As part of Nippon Steel, the company also benefits from an international network of metallurgical knowledge. 
Ovako is looking for a Senior R&D Engineer with expertise in alloy design and materials performance to strengthen its R&D organisation in Hofors, Sweden. 
This role offers the opportunity to combine advanced metallurgical research with customer-driven industrial development. You will investigate how steel composition and processing influence material properties, develop new alloy concepts and tackle complex challenges arising from real applications. Working closely with customers and sales, you will help translate specific performance requirements into material solutions, gaining insight into a range of industries and seeing how your research contributes to customers’ development journeys. 
About the roleAs a Senior R&D Engineer, you will drive research activities in alloy design, steel development and materials performance, combining computational modelling, experimental investigations and collaboration with external research partners. 
Approximately 60% of your time will be dedicated to customer projects. You will investigate material behaviour, assess application requirements and develop steel solutions to meet demanding performance needs. The challenges will vary across applications and industries, giving you the opportunity to apply your scientific expertise to a broad range of practical problems. You will also support product development at Ovako’s production mills, helping connect customer requirements, material performance and industrial processes. 
Collaboration with universities and research institutes is an important part of the role, alongside participation in nationally and internationally funded research projects. You will have opportunities to expand your technical network through research partnerships, conferences and occasional travel to research institutes and other Ovako sites in Europe. 
Your responsibilities 
Developing new steel grades and alloy concepts, from composition to processing route 
Computational alloy design using Thermo-Calc and related tools 
Planning and evaluating corrosion testing data and hydrogen embrittlement investigations 
Driving nationally and internationally funded research projects and consortia 
Collaborating with universities and institutes, including supervision of students 
Supporting sales and customers with qualified answers on material behaviour and selection 
Identifying new research directions that strengthen Ovako's product portfolio and long-term competitiveness 

The position is placed in Hofors, Sweden, with possibilities to work 2 days a week from home.  
Your profileYou are a scientifically driven metallurgist or materials scientist who enjoys exploring the mechanisms behind material behaviour and applying research to complex industrial challenges. You are motivated by understanding why materials behave the way they do and using that knowledge to develop solutions to problems without obvious answers. 
We are looking for someone with: 
A PhD in metallurgy or materials science, with a strong focus on steels and metallic materials. 
At least three years of research experience after your PhD, gained at a university, company R&D centre or research institute. 
Documented expertise in steel alloy design, including hands-on experience with Thermo-Calc. 
Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to explain complex technical findings to different audiences, including customers. 

You should also have experience in nationally or internationally funded research collaborations. 
Meritorious experience:Experience from research or development projects related to corrosion of metallic materials and hydrogen embrittlement of steels is considered an advantage, as these topics represent important current and future challenges within several of Ovako’s research collaborations and customer-driven development projects. 
Who are you?You are curious, analytical and persistent in your approach to research. You enjoy challenging established assumptions, investigating mechanisms and building the evidence needed to understand complex materials problems. 
You combine scientific rigour with a collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly, share knowledge and work effectively with colleagues, customers, production teams and external research partners. 
Ovako's core values are Innovative, Skilled and Responsible. The company looks for people who demonstrate these values through their expertise, curiosity and commitment to continuous improvement. 
Why Ovako?At Ovako, you will work with advanced specialty steel in an environment where scientific research meets real industrial challenges. You will collaborate with experienced specialists, customers, universities and research institutes, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and contribute to the development of future steel solutions. 
As part of Nippon Steel, you will also benefit from an international network of metallurgical knowledge and research collaboration.

This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.
Our Boden Site
Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.
